questions.a: ADDRESSING vs ACTION: the-cli-reaches-any-device is the addressing layer (making every device reachable). This is the action layer (what you can DO once you reach a device). They compose.

STANDARD vs DEVICE-SPECIFIC: the standard set is SMALL and reserved (get, show, list). Device-specific verbs are OPEN. The vocabulary governs standard verbs; device verbs are unconstrained beyond not colliding.
LONG FORM vs SHORTCUT: 'cairn device get thing' is the standard; 'cairnhelp' is a shortcut. The vocabulary is the source; shortcuts are views.
